description: Mobile UI/UX Premium Polish — Cross-platform (iOS + Android) initiative to elevate the mobile experience so it soars above the competition. Focuses on premium visual identity, delightful micro-interactions, contextual haptic feedback, a compelling paid-tier feel, animated navigation, hero parallax, conversational trip planning, map overhaul, and accessibility. Builds on the completed Mobile Security & Auth Hardening and Android App Audit PRDs.

userStories.title: Add biometric authentication (Fingerprint / Face) to Android

Handle all BiometricPrompt error codes gracefully (ERROR_HW_UNAVAILABLE, ERROR_NO_BIOMETRICS, ERROR_LOCKOUT, etc.)
Clear biometric preference on sign out
userStories.notes: FIXED: Created BiometricAuthService.kt with Class 3 (strong) biometric support via AndroidX Biometric library. Uses BiometricPrompt with suspend/resume for coroutine integration. Preference stored securely in EncryptedSharedPreferences via SecureStorage. Biometric lock screen on app launch with retry. All BiometricPrompt error codes handled (ERROR_HW_UNAVAILABLE, ERROR_NO_BIOMETRICS, ERROR_LOCKOUT, ERROR_LOCKOUT_PERMANENT, ERROR_TIMEOUT, etc.). Biometric preference cleared on sign out via AuthViewModel. MainActivity extended to FragmentActivity for BiometricPrompt compatibility.

userStories.title: Add certificate pinning for Supabase API calls on Android

userStories.notes: FIXED: Created CertificatePinningService.kt with OkHttp CertificatePinner using same SPKI SHA-256 hashes as iOS (Let's Encrypt R3, ISRG Root X1, DigiCert Global Root G2). Integrated into SupabaseClientProvider via Ktor OkHttp engine. Debug mode uses report-only (logs but allows), production mode blocks mismatches. Pins *.supabase.co domain.

userStories.notes: FIXED: Created RootDetector.kt matching iOS JailbreakDetector.swift with 5 checks: su binary paths, root management apps (Magisk, SuperSU, Xposed, etc.), suspicious paths, test-keys in Build.TAGS, writable system paths. Skips checks on emulator to avoid false positives. Shows non-blocking AlertDialog warning on app launch. Integrated into MainActivity with dismissible warning.

userStories.title: Upgrade server-side rate limiting to database-backed storage

Original checkRateLimit() kept synchronous for backward compatibility — all 35+ edge functions continue working unchanged.

userStories.title: Accessibility audit — dynamic type, contrast, TalkBack/VoiceOver labels, larger hit targets
userStories.description: As a user with accessibility needs, I want the app to fully support dynamic type, high contrast, and screen readers so I can use every feature.
acceptanceCriteria: All interactive elements have a minimum 44x44pt / 48x48dp hit target
All icon-only buttons have a contentDescription / accessibilityLabel
Text scales with system font setting without layout breaks (tested at 200%)
Color pairs verified for 4.5:1 contrast ratio (AA)
Screen reader reads cards as a single element with an aggregated label (e.g., "Jazz in July, Friday 7 PM, Western Gateway Park, free")
Focus order follows visual order on every screen
iOS + Android parity

userStories.title: Dark mode polish — OLED true-black option and refined surface hierarchy
userStories.description: As a user who prefers dark mode, I want an OLED-friendly true-black option and carefully chosen surface layers so the app looks premium in dark mode.
acceptanceCriteria: Settings toggle: System / Light / Dark / OLED (true black)

Verify every screen for contrast and that no pure-white elements appear in OLED mode

iOS + Android parity
